vo01: Meet Credence. A simpler way to understand where your money actually goes.
vo02: Just drop in your bank statement. Even a password-protected PDF works.
vo03: Credence reads every single line, and turns all that UPI and NEFT jargon into plain, simple categories.
vo04: And instead of a dashboard you'll never open, you get your money, wrapped. Your top app. And what it really cost you, in hours of work.
vo05: Your money personality. That gym membership you forgot about. Roast mode, or hype mode. Your call.
vo06: And what three small habits could turn into, for future you.
vo07: Everything behind the story is right here. Hover to explore, and click to dig into the actual transactions.
vo08: Plan for later, or check which friends still owe you money.
vo09: Or just ask. In English, or in Hinglish. Every number in the answer comes from your own statement, and Credence checks each one, live.
vo10: And this isn't a scripted demo. A different person, with a different bank, gets a completely different story.
vo11: Credence. Your bank statement, told like a story.
